verdict.rationale: Recruitee exposes REST API endpoints (candidates, offers, departments) that could be used to pull data out programmatically, but there is no documented bulk 'export all data' feature, data portability guarantee, or open-format (CSV/JSON) export tool for a full account/account-closure export. missing for 10: explicit data export/portability documentation, open-format bulk export tool, account closure/data takeout process.
